change.source: pass 2 finding 2 (a reconnect whose open got no answer ends the wake with 1 and a line that is not true): the wake takes the pause of a failure and reads again; NotOpen has its own words for no record, a refused open and not open right after an open; adversary_wake_2::a_reopen_that_gets_no_answer_does_not_end_the_wake_as_never_opened. The guard against a second not-open right after an open stays, also for 2 restarts in a row; the story's Decisions say so
